description_en: Queries the multi-account authorization assignment list under multi-account authorization management
description_zh: 多账号授权管理下查询多账号授权分配列表
name: ListMultiUserInstances

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。取值范围：10 - 100，默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token used for paging. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 用于分页查询。首次请求请留空，后续请求请填入上次响应返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token
